stories.title: Add Streamlit config for mobile compatibility
stories.acceptance_criteria: .streamlit/config.toml exists with [server] section (enableCORS=false, enableXsrfProtection=false) and [browser] section (gatherUsageStats=false).

stories.title: Inject viewport meta tag
stories.acceptance_criteria: tythe_time_tracker/ui/app.py contains st.markdown() call with viewport meta tag (width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0) using unsafe_allow_html=True, placed right after set_page_config.

stories.title: Responsive layout adjustments
stories.acceptance_criteria: layout='wide' removed or conditionally applied. Custom CSS added via st.markdown for mobile: reduced padding on small screens, tap-friendly button sizes (min 44px), sidebar auto-collapse on mobile. Media queries target screens under 768px.

stories.title: Pin Streamlit version for mobile fixes
stories.acceptance_criteria: requirements.txt has streamlit>=1.32.0 (up from >=1.28.0). No import or config errors with the updated version constraint.
